title_zh: CREATOR：通过工具创建解耦大语言模型的抽象推理与具体推理
one_line: LLM creates documented code tools per problem, decides their use, executes, and rectifies from tracebacks; created tools can transfer to related queries.
one_line_zh: LLM为问题编写带文档的代码工具，再决定调用、执行并依报错回溯修正，工具可迁移到同概念的问题。

retained_ablation.quote: Through the application of transferred tools, the LLM’s accuracy can be raised by 15.3%.

code.quote: All the codes and data are released.

evidence_level.quote: Creator achieves an accuracy of 59.7%, 94.7%, and 75.5% respectively on three tasks, surpassing all the best performance in baselines by large margins.

S3.quote: Then, we test if the correct tool created under one scenario could be applied to the other two, and again test the LLM’s performance.

S4.quote: we provide the original tool implementation and calling decision in [ORI] , offer the error tracebacks [ERR] , and concatenate natural language reasoning on the error with the rectified code in [REC] .

S5.quote: Through the application of transferred tools, the LLM’s accuracy can be raised by 15.3%.
